title: Reviewing store requests
summary: KloudC masters: review a new store's request, approve it with a starter pack, or reject it with a note.

blocks.text: The **Requests** tab lists stores asking to join, waiting for review. Open one to see the store's name, requested Store ID, contact, time zone and POS.

items: Check the request looks real and the Store ID is sensible.
Pick the **starter pack** (and change the Store ID or time zone if needed).
Click **Approve and set up**. RetailOps creates the store's database, loads the pack and creates the owner's admin login.
Watch it on the **Stores** tab. The owner signs in with the Store ID and the password they chose.

blocks.text: **Reject** asks why. The note is shown on the requester's status page, so keep it friendly and clear.
If set-up fails, the store shows Setup failed on Stores with the step it stopped at. Fix the cause, then **Retry set-up**.
